Interface PaymentService

All Known Implementing Classes:
PaymentServiceImpl
public interface PaymentService
Service interface for Payment CRUD operations.

All read operations are executed in a read-only transaction. Write operations (create, update, partialUpdate, delete) participate in a full read-write transaction.

Every method that returns payment data produces a PaymentResponseDto — a flat representation that includes only the ID of the related rental (rentalId). PaymentRequestDto is used exclusively as the inbound write payload.

    • create

      PaymentResponseDto create(PaymentRequestDto dto)
      Create a new payment.
      Parameters:
      dto - the payment data; dto.id() is ignored — the ID is DB-generated
      Returns:
      the persisted payment as a flat PaymentResponseDto

    • update

      PaymentResponseDto update(Integer id, PaymentRequestDto dto)
      Fully replace all fields of an existing payment.
      Parameters:
      id - path-variable payment ID
      dto - new field values; all non-ID fields are overwritten
      Returns:
      the updated payment as a flat PaymentResponseDto
      Throws:
      com.me.learning.framework.web.errors.ResourceNotFoundException - if the payment or the supplied rental does not exist

    • partialUpdate

      PaymentResponseDto partialUpdate(Integer id, PaymentRequestDto dto)
      Partially update an existing payment — only non-null DTO fields are applied.
      Parameters:
      id - path-variable payment ID
      dto - partial field values; null fields are left unchanged
      Returns:
      the updated payment as a flat PaymentResponseDto
      Throws:
      com.me.learning.framework.web.errors.ResourceNotFoundException - if the payment or the supplied rental does not exist
